+import pandas as pd
+import joblib
+from scorer.model import fit, scores
+from scorer.serve import score_request
+from scorer.predict import main as predict_main
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+import os
+
+def test_train_serve_parity():
+    """Ensure online scoring (serve) matches batch scoring (predict) for same inputs."""
+    frame = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
+    model = fit(frame)
+    
+    # Test on first 5 rows
+    for i in range(min(5, len(frame))):
+        row = frame.iloc[i]
+        payload = row.to_dict()
+        
+        # Online score via serve
+        online_score = score_request(payload, model)
+        
+        # Batch score via predict path
+        batch_scores = scores(pd.DataFrame([row]), model)
+        batch_score = float(batch_scores[0])
+        
+        assert abs(online_score - batch_score) < 1e-10, f"Row {i}: online={online_score}, batch={batch_score}"
+
+def test_holdout_non_inferior():
+    """Ensure model quality on holdout doesn't degrade."""
+    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
+    
+    train_frame = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
+    holdout_frame = pd.read_csv("data/holdout_features.csv")
+    
+    model = fit(train_frame)
+    holdout_scores = scores(holdout_frame, model)
+    
+    # Need holdout labels - check if outcome column exists
+    if "outcome" in holdout_frame.columns:
+        auc = roc_auc_score(holdout_frame.outcome, holdout_scores)
+        # Baseline AUC should be reasonable (above random)
+        assert auc > 0.5, f"Holdout AUC {auc} is not better than random"
+    else:
+        # If no labels, just verify scores are valid probabilities
+        assert all(0 <= s <= 1 for s in holdout_scores), "Scores must be valid probabilities"
